address.lineWithUnit: 8 North Sound Beach Avenue Extension Unit 4

remarks: Perfect location in Riverside. Outstanding 4 level end-unit with 3532 sq. feet of privacy. This is a sophisticated & elegant townhouse that spares no expense in its features and construction. The train is only a few minutes drive as well as Binney Park. Tod's Point Beach is a short drive away as well as the Ferry to Island Beach. You are very close to schools, restaurants, golfing, shopping, & the Bruce Museum. A beautiful custom mahogany front door opens to a foyer that guides you to an open floor plan with rooms boasting 10 ft. ceilings. The gourmet kitchen has custom cabinets w/ an outstanding center island measuring approx. 6'8 by 4'8 that holds a wine cooler! Sliders from DR gives you easy exit to a beautiful stone patio & private yard. Four large spacious bedrooms are found on the 2nd floor w/ with lots of closet space & a laundry room as well. The Primary Bedroom has a beautiful, large ensuite bathroom w/ a spa like feel and a great walk-in closet. The top-level bonus room can function as an office/ playroom/recreation room or even as a 5th bedroom. The Lower Level is fully finished and has a full bath, offering an in-law/nanny suite option. Enjoy "single family" style living WITHOUT the expense of exterior maintenance and landscaping costs that usually accompany single family rentals. Be prepared to be wowed! Schools are Dundee Elementary, Eastern Middle & Greenwich High. Photos are from prior listing. (Unit may have audio/ or visual surveillance.)
